questions.prompt: Your friend has one sandwich and gives you half of it. What does he do?

options.text: He shares his sandwich.
He tidies his sandwich.
He collects his sandwich.
He cleans up his sandwich.

questions.explanation: Giving a part of what you have to somebody else is sharing, and that is exactly what caring for a friend looks like. You tidy a room and not a sandwich, you collect things to put them together, and you clean up a place that is dirty.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: "The little boy plays ___ in the garden. Nobody is with him."

options.text: together
alone
tidy
each other

questions.explanation: Nobody is with him, so he plays alone. The word "together" says the opposite, that several people are there, "tidy" describes a room where everything is in its place, and "each other" needs at least two people who do something to one another.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: "My aunt cleans the school every evening. She is a ___ ."

options.text: clean
cleans
cleaning
cleaner

questions.explanation: The person who does the action is the verb plus -er: clean + er = a cleaner. The word "clean" is the bare verb or the adjective, "cleans" is the she form of the verb, and "cleaning" names the activity, so none of the three can name the woman herself.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a correct promise for next week?

options.text: Next week I will helping my neighbour.
Next week I will help my neighbour.
Next week I will helps my neighbour.
Next week I will to help my neighbour.

questions.explanation: Next week is in the future, and the future is will plus the bare verb, whoever the subject is: I will help my neighbour. After will the verb takes no -ing ("will helping"), no -s ("will helps") and no little word to ("will to help").

questions.prompt: Amine's dog is 2 years old, Sarra's dog is 5 and Karim's dog is 9. Which sentence is correct?

options.text: Amine's dog is the oldest of the three.
Sarra's dog is the oldest of the three.
Karim's dog is the oldest of the three.
Karim's dog is the youngest of the three.

questions.explanation: Karim's dog is 9, above Sarra's dog at 5 and Amine's dog at 2, so it beats the whole group and takes the superlative the oldest. Amine's dog at 2 is in fact the youngest, Sarra's dog at 5 sits in the middle, and calling the dog of 9 years the youngest turns the three numbers upside down.

questions.prompt: Your little brother has a new cat. Which sentence is completely correct?

options.text: Take care of your cat, and don't hit it.
Take care of your cat, and not hit it.
Take care of you cat, and don't hit it.
You take care of your cat, and don't hits it.

questions.explanation: The order starts with the bare verb and names nobody, the owner of the cat is your brother so the word is your, and the prohibition is Don't plus the bare verb. The form "not hit it" copies the negative word of another language, "you cat" uses the subject you where the possessive your is needed, and "You take care" turns the order into a statement while "don't hits" adds an -s after Don't.
